Chapter 5

Users, Roles & Permissions

Kis ko kya access dena hai — invite, roles, branch restriction, custom roles aur best practices.

5.1 Bunyadi concepts

  • Permission — aik chhota sa haq, jaise "Approve invoices" (invoices.approve) ya "View employees" (employees.view). System mein ~90 permissions hain (Appendix A.3).
  • Role — permissions ka aik bundle, jaise "Accountant" ya "HR Manager". User ko permissions direct nahi, roles ke zariye milti hain.
  • User ki access = us ke tamam roles ki permissions ka majmooa (union). Aik user ke do roles hon to dono ki permissions milti hain.
  • Company-wise — roles har company ke andar alag hote hain. Aik shakhs Company A mein Accountant aur Company B mein Employee ho sakta hai.
  • Branch restriction — user ko sirf kuch branches ke data tak mehdood kiya ja sakta hai.
Tip
Sidebar mein sirf wohi menus nazar aate hain jin ki permission ho. Lekin asal hifazat server par hoti hai — Chapter 6 dekhein.

5.2 Das (10) default roles

Har nayi company ko yeh 10 system roles khud-ba-khud milte hain:

Table 5.1 — Default roles (Northwind demo company se ginti)
RoleKis ke liyePermissions
Company OwnerFull access to everything in the company.89
Company AdministratorManages users, settings and all modules except payroll processing.88
HR ManagerEmployees, attendance, leave, performance and payroll.28
AccountantFinance, accounting, invoices, bills, payments and financial reports.31
Sales ManagerCustomers, leads, quotations, sales orders and invoices.22
Inventory ManagerProducts, warehouses and all stock operations.20
Procurement OfficerSuppliers, requisitions, purchase orders and goods receipts.18
Department ManagerApproves leave, requisitions and expenses for their team; manages projects.24
EmployeeSelf-service: own leave, expenses, tasks, time and payslips.10
Read-Only AuditorReads every module including audit logs; cannot change anything.36

Note
Ahem farq: Company Administrator ke paas sab kuch hai siwaye "Run & approve payroll" (payroll.process) ke — payroll chalana HR Manager/Owner ka kaam hai. Procurement Officer purchase orders bana/manage kar sakta hai lekin approve nahi — PO approval Owner/Admin karte hain. Read-Only Auditor har module dekh sakta hai, audit log bhi, aur reports export kar sakta hai, lekin kuch badal nahi sakta.

5.4 Naya user invite karna

  1. Sidebar mein Users & roles → Users kholein.
  2. Upar right Invite user button dabayein — right side se aik drawer khulega.
  3. Full name aur Work email bharein (dono lazmi).
  4. Roles mein aik ya zyada roles tick karein. Hint: "Permissions are the union of all assigned roles."
  5. Access to all branches — default on. Agar user ko sirf kuch branches tak rakhna hai to off karein aur Allowed branches mein branches chunein (5.5).
  6. Invite/save karein. Naye shakhs ko email milti hai jis ke link se woh apna password khud set karta hai. Agar email pehle se kisi account ki hai, to usi account ko company mein add kar diya jata hai.
Tip
User ne abhi tak login nahi kiya to row ke actions menu mein Resend invitation option hota hai.
